title: Navisworks Technical Coordination Workflow
trigger: Federated desktop coordination is required for heavy assembly, advanced clash execution, viewpoint review, offline review, or evidence packaging.

steps.action: Create or update the governed NWF coordination container, identify the coordination scope and included source versions, and verify shared-coordinate alignment before relying on federation results.
Apply governed search/selection sets and define the applicable clash tests from the project clash-matrix configuration without inventing enterprise numeric tolerances or discipline pairs.
Execute the clash matrix, deduplicate and classify findings, preserve the model/test context, and prepare reproducible viewpoints or other review evidence.

During coordination review, use curated Navisworks viewpoints or sections to examine findings, but create or synchronize every governed actionable issue in the project-designated issue system of record with traceable model/version context.

Assignees correct the authoritative source information; Navisworks transforms, appearance overrides, viewpoints, or local status changes shall not substitute for correction of the source model or authoritative issue state.
Re-federate the corrected source versions, re-run applicable tests, verify resolved conditions, and reflect verification or closure in the governed issue system of record.

For a governed coordination gate or milestone, package the required Navisworks outputs as evidence only to the extent declared by the project exchange/records requirements, and record coordination sign-off through the applicable governed review/sign-off process.

meeting_rules: Navisworks may be used as the technical review environment for coordination meetings, including viewpoints, sections, search/selection sets, and clash results.
Meeting discussion or a Navisworks result does not by itself create formal issue, acceptance, or sign-off authority.
Meeting notes and decisions that affect governed issues shall reference the corresponding issue identifiers or governed evidence records.
evidence_requirements: identifiable source-model versions used for the review
applicable clash-matrix/profile version or configuration basis
traceable governed issue identifiers for actionable findings
declared coordination gate or milestone when sign-off evidence is packaged
system_of_record_boundary: Navisworks is a technical coordination and evidence-generation environment, not an authority source merely because a result exists there. Formal coordination issues, review decisions, acceptance evidence, and sign-off records shall remain in the project-designated governed system of record. Where ACC is the project-designated system, Navisworks findings shall be synchronized to the applicable ACC issue/review/transmittal process rather than maintained as an unsynchronized parallel tracker.
output_classification: NWF, NWD, clash reports, viewpoints, screenshots, and issue exports do not acquire deliverable, record, or acceptance status from file format alone; classification is governed by S7 and the applicable project exchange, BEP, CDE, and records requirements.

provenance.migration_note: Completed object-level migration by integrating the source-supported meeting, issue traceability, verification, evidence and system-of-record boundaries into the existing desktop workflow. Draft platform-preference statements, exact folder paths, exporter toggles, retention durations, and unresolved authority assignments are not promoted.
